title: Spec of a directed colimit of rings is the limit of the spectra
statement: Let $(C_i,\varphi_{ii'})$ be a directed system of commutative rings over a directed set $I$, with colimit $C=\varinjlim_iC_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then $\operatorname{Spec}C$, with the morphisms $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}C_i$ induced by the coprojections, is the limit of the inverse system $(\operatorname{Spec}C_i)$ in the category of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and the transition morphisms $\operatorname{Spec}C_{i'}\to\operatorname{Spec}C_i$ are affine [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] (a morphism between affine schemes is affine).
